summary: Valid, well-sourced label-free SDRF (72 runs, files/replicates/search params independently confirmed), but the factor design merges anti-FLAG bait IPs and IgG control IPs into the same 4 conditions, so any factor-driven reanalysis treats bait and control runs as replicates of one condition.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent with no producer transcript; producer manifest/report treated as untrusted and re-checked against PRIDE, PMC9540350, .msf range reads and OLS

spec_compliance.evidence: 38 columns in correct order; templates ms-proteomics v1.2.0 (sdrf-pipelines 0.1.7 bundle; spec submodule only ships 1.1.0, delta is 3 optional columns), vertebrates v1.1.0, clinical-metadata v1.0.0; reserved words only where allow_* permit; mod syntax with PP=Protein N-term correct; (source name, assay name, label) unique on all 72 rows.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS4 obo_id lookups (ols_check.txt): NCBITaxon:10090, UBERON:0000956, MONDO:0007739, PATO:0000461, EFO:0001272, PRIDE:0000627, MS:1002523, MS:1001251, MS:1000422, PRIDE:0000609, PRIDE:0000600, MS:1000484, UNIMOD:4/35/7/766 all exact-label, non-obsolete; study sample=PRIDE:0001013, negative control=PRIDE:0000905. sdrf-tools check's 'hallucinated Met-loss+Acetyl' is a tool false positive (OLS confirms UNIMOD:766 = Met-loss+Acetyl).

source_evidence.evidence: PMC9540350 (title/accession asserted): label-free FLAG IP-MS from cortex of Htt3xFlagQ20/+ and Q140/+ mice at 2 and 10 months, triplicate with parallel IgG IPs, C57BL/6J congenic, male and female (sex matched within replicate, per-replicate sex not given), TCEP/chloroacetamide, 3 StageTip fractions, DDA on Q Exactive HF. Search params re-read from a second msf (20210806_2M-140Q-IgG_F, tail 80 MiB): Sequest 4 ppm/0.02 Da, Carbamidomethyl C static, Oxidation M + Deamidated N dynamic, only N-term mod set = Met-loss+Acetyl; no quantification method.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE files/all (projectAccessions=[PXD034158]): 84 .raw. LFQ 72 unique + SILAC 12 unique = 84, no overlap, none missing, none extra, no peak lists. rerun files are the only deposited copies. Rep folders spot-checked in 3 .msf headers (rep1 20210821_2M-20Q-IgG, rep3 20210819_10M-20Q-FLAG, rep1 20210806_2M-140Q-IgG) match the SDRF.

design_consistency.evidence: 24 sources = 2 ages x 2 genotypes x 3 reps x {FLAG,IgG}, 3 fractions each: consistent. But factor values are only age+genotype; producer's own convert-openms log shows 4 conditions x 18 files, each = 9 FLAG + 9 IgG runs.

omission_safety.evidence: Inferred values (adult, HCD, orbitrap, fragment tol over paper's '20 ppm') are disclosed and supported by instrument/msf; sex and fractionation chemistry left 'not available' rather than guessed; no invented sample maps.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates -t clinical-metadata: exit 0 (one warning: C57BL/6J not in NCBITaxon). sdrf-tools check exit 1 solely for the UNIMOD:766 false positive refuted in OLS. sdrf-tools score 97/100.

findings.message: Bait (anti-FLAG, study sample) and control (IgG, negative control) IPs are not separated by any factor value, so each of the 4 conditions mixes 9 FLAG and 9 IgG runs, and each biological replicate number appears twice per condition under different sources.
findings.evidence: convert-openms in PXD034158.validation.txt: Conditions (4), Files per condition 18; characteristics[sample type] is the only column distinguishing FLAG from IgG.
findings.correction: Add a factor that distinguishes FLAG-IP from IgG-IP (e.g. factor value[sample type] mirroring characteristics[sample type]) so conversion yields 8 conditions of 9 runs; re-run validate and convert-openms.

findings.message: Factor has no matching characteristics/comment column (sdrf-tools score design issue); characteristics[age] is licensed only by the human template, so this is a disclosed spec limitation.
findings.evidence: score.txt; human/1.1.0 is the only template with characteristics[age].
findings.correction: Optional; keep as is or record age in a licensed column if the spec adds one.

findings.message: C57BL/6J not resolvable in NCBITaxon (validator warning); conventional value used across the repo.
sdrf-tools check reports UNIMOD:766 Met-loss+Acetyl as hallucinated; OLS confirms it, so this is a checker false positive.
findings.correction: None for the SDRF; tool issue.
